# Core

The thread list, tabs, chat, composer, session control, Settings, AI accounts and Getting started every other pack builds on.

Pack id `core`, always on: every other pack builds on it. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/thread-sidebar`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/thread-sidebar/README.md) — Replace the DSH sidebar with project-scoped thread groups and customizable navigation.
2. [`@dshfiles/main-tabs`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/main-tabs/README.md) — Browser-like tabs above the main view for threads and global panels: pin, reorder, preview, shortcuts, per-project persistence.
3. [`@dshfiles/chat`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/chat/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's native Chat plugin that mounts only the transcript rows near the viewport.
4. [`@dshfiles/rich-composer`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/rich-composer/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's native Conversation plugin with structured session-reference paste.
5. [`@dshfiles/session-controller`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/session-controller/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's native Session controller that sends the browser only what it renders.
6. [`@dshfiles/settings-shell`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/settings-shell/README.md) — VS Code-style DSH Settings shell with plugin settings, search, and notices for new DSH releases.
7. [`@dshfiles/onboarding`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/onboarding/README.md) — Getting started: a Knowledge page with a self-ticking setup checklist, plugin packs, what changed in owned plugins since your last visit and a searchable gallery of every catalogued feature, a three-step setup wizard while no thread is open, and read-only onboarding_overview and…
8. [`@dshfiles/ai-accounts`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/ai-accounts/README.md) — Per-account Codex, Claude, OpenCode Go and Command Code provider instances, plus Cursor quota, for DeepSeek Harness, in the spirit of T3 Code.
9. [`@dshfiles/frame-layout`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/frame-layout/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's native layout package: the three-column AppFrame with browser-persisted panel widths.
10. [`@dshfiles/workbench`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/workbench/README.md) — Docking workbench in the main slot: registered panels move, split, tab and float without remounting; the layout persists.
11. [`@dshfiles/ui-styles`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/ui-styles/README.md) — The one bundle that compiles and injects the shared plugin-ui Tailwind stylesheet (the ordered union of every owned plugin's classes) and owns the Appearance theme: presets, palette and font settings, and the theme agent tools
12. [`@dshfiles/command-palette`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/command-palette/README.md) — The app-wide searchable command palette and plugin action registry.
13. [`@dshfiles/shortcuts`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/shortcuts/README.md) — Capture-phase keyboard shortcuts in layers (chords, single keys, sequences) and the ? shortcut sheet
14. [`@dshfiles/workspace-nav`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/workspace-nav/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's native workspace picker: a New thread opens its composer before the Host creates the Session.
15. [`@dshfiles/workspace-folder-picker`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/workspace-folder-picker/README.md) — Provide Host-backed folder browsing for workspace and project pickers.
16. [`@dshfiles/model-selection`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/model-selection/README.md) — Owned native model directory, composer seat and /model popup with local draft selection.
17. [`@dshfiles/agent-preset`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/agent-preset/README.md) — Owned native preset surfaces with client-local Session draft selection.
18. [`@dshfiles/input-trigger`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/input-trigger/README.md) — Owned MIT fork of DSH's shared / and @ autocomplete engine with Codex-style @ token targeting.
19. [`@dshfiles/send-after-upload`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/send-after-upload/README.md) — Queue the send when Enter or Send is pressed while an attachment is still uploading.
20. [`@dshfiles/user-questions`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/user-questions/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's native question form: markdown questions with sandboxed HTML previews, and an answered question stays closed while its reply waits for admission.
21. [`@dshfiles/deliverables`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/deliverables/README.md) — Owned native changed-files card, review tab and delivery cards that preview changed images instead of the binary placeholder.
22. [`@dshfiles/cordis-cards`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/cordis-cards/README.md) — Owned native Cordis cards and panel whose inventory read waits for the connection instead of rereading on its first reset.
23. [`@dshfiles/settings-models`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/settings-models/README.md) — Owned native Models settings page and onboarding dialogs that refresh once per burst and only while shown.
24. [`@dshfiles/settings-subagent`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/settings-subagent/README.md) — Owned native Subagent settings page whose model catalog read waits for the connection and is shared page-wide.
25. [`@dshfiles/settings-web-search`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/settings-web-search/README.md) — Owned native Web search settings page that reads its credential only while shown, once per burst.

## Prerequisites

1. An AI account is configured.
2. A project is added.

## Key settings

1. **Restart by itself when idle to apply updates**: Settings entry `thread-sidebar`, field `autoRestartWhenIdle`.

## Enable it

Core is always on: Getting started offers no Enable or Disable for it, `onboarding_pack_apply` never disables it, and `dshx init` composes it into every profile.

To compose a new profile with Core only: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs core`.

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
